name: Gemma 3 12B IT (multimodal)
notes: TWO-PART MODEL. Identical vision design to Gemma 3 4B: SigLIP, 27 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 896, no pooling -- 4,096 vision tokens per image. VISION DOMINATES, same as 4B. (2) LLM: 48 layers, hidden 3840, 16 heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 256, intermediate 15360, vocab 262,208, max_position 131,072, rope_theta 1e6, rope_scaling {factor 8.0, linear}, sliding_window 1024. ARCHITECTURE = dense. KV CACHE: 48 * 8 * 256 * 2 * 2 = 393,216 B/token (384 KiB) -- the largest KV-per-token of any model in this slice. At 131,072 ctx that is 48.0 GiB per sequence at bf16. Same caveat as the 4B: only the 8 global-attention layers need full-length KV, the 40 sliding layers cap at 1,024 tokens, so a correct implementation stores ~6x less than this headline figure. params_b 12.187 = HF API safetensors total (12,187,325,040). PROVENANCE: gated repo (401 on raw config.json); fields read from the unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it mirror with the param total cross-checked against the gated repo's HF API entry.
